input_artifacts.note: T01 read-only inventory selected codex_local_builtin as the preliminary next remediation probe. This T02 packet records the subsequent human-approved refinement: keep Paperclip-owned hermes_local execution and configure Hermes to use Codex CLI as its internal LLM backend.
Collaborative decision saved after user confirmed the Hermes-local plus Codex-backend path.

approval_scope.path_selection_source: Human confirmed: use Paperclip-owned hermes_local execution with Hermes using Codex CLI internally as the LLM/backend provider.
approval_scope.why_still_required: The selected path is approved, but any Paperclip sandbox mutation, adapter configuration change, or provider execution remains an outward-facing state-changing action and requires fresh explicit confirmation immediately before execution.

selected_path_summary.description: Paperclip invokes the registered hermes_local adapter; Hermes runs inside that Paperclip-owned adapter/run lifecycle; Hermes is configured to use Codex CLI as its internal LLM/backend provider instead of the OpenAI/Xiaomi env-key path that failed in S02.
what_it_proves_if_smoke_passes: Paperclip can execute a hermes_local agent when Hermes is backed by Codex CLI.
The run can produce BOS-shaped structured result evidence through Paperclip readback.
The remediation avoids plaintext provider key injection, core patches, direct DB mutation, and private registry internals.
what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove the original OpenAI/Xiaomi secret_ref materialization path is fixed.
It does not prove generic codex_local adapter execution unless a separate codex_local smoke is run.
It does not prove gsdpi_local registration or Div4 GSD-Pi automation.

path_comparison.label: Fix hermes_local OpenAI/Xiaomi secret_ref materialization
path_comparison.supported_boundary: Paperclip hermes_local adapter plus supported secret_ref resolution into runtime config
benefits: Would directly resolve the S02 blocker for the original provider setup.
Keeps Paperclip adapter lifecycle and result readback intact.
risks: Existing evidence shows hermes-paperclip-adapter@0.2.0 uses persisted agent adapterConfig.env rather than resolved runtime config for subprocess env.
Fix may require upstream adapter/runtime change not available through current supported project boundaries.
path_comparison.security_posture: Safe only if secret refs are resolved by Paperclip at execution time without plaintext persistence or logging.
proof_required: Passing hermes_local testEnvironment using secret refs.
One bounded Paperclip run with resultJson.bos or resultJson.bosAdapterResult.
path_comparison.reason_not_selected: It targets the root bug but appears blocked by installed adapter behavior unless Paperclip exposes a supported fix.

path_comparison.label: Register gsdpi_local through supported external adapter mechanism
path_comparison.supported_boundary: Documented Paperclip external-adapter/plugin registration plus registry/testEnvironment readback
benefits: Would support Div4/GSD-Pi-specific quality automation with a BOS-shaped BosAdapterResult contract.
Local adapter candidate already has fail-closed tests and secret redaction behavior.
risks: Paperclip currently returns Unknown adapter type: gsdpi_local.
No supported registration/install readback is available in existing evidence.
Attempting direct registry mutation, core patching, or private module imports would violate S08 constraints.
path_comparison.security_posture: Potentially safe after supported registration, but currently unproved and not executable.
proof_required: Registry readback showing gsdpi_local loaded and enabled.
Passing testEnvironment and one bounded BosAdapterResult smoke.
path_comparison.reason_not_selected: Blocked before execution by missing Paperclip adapter registration boundary.

path_comparison.label: Use Paperclip codex_local built-in adapter directly
path_comparison.supported_boundary: Paperclip codex_local built-in adapter registry and future bounded smoke
benefits: Existing registry readback shows codex_local loaded with models.
risks: No codex_local testEnvironment or runtime smoke evidence exists yet.
This would prove Codex execution, not Hermes remediation.
Codex session/credential posture still needs redacted proof.
path_comparison.security_posture: Potentially safe if invoked only through Paperclip adapter lifecycle and no plaintext secrets are configured.
proof_required: One bounded Paperclip run with BOS-shaped structured result.
No side effects, no plaintext credentials, no core changes.
path_comparison.reason_not_selected: Useful fallback, but the human-selected path is Hermes remediation via Codex as Hermes backend, preserving hermes_local semantics.

path_comparison.label: Paperclip hermes_local adapter with Hermes using Codex CLI internally
path_comparison.supported_boundary: Paperclip registered hermes_local adapter owns agent/run lifecycle; Hermes provider/backend configuration points to Codex CLI without Paperclip core patches or plaintext key injection.
benefits: Preserves Paperclip lifecycle, run ids, status, logs/readback, permissions, and resultJson contract.
Avoids the failed OpenAI/Xiaomi env-key materialization path if Hermes can use local Codex auth/session as backend.
Keeps the proof focused on Hermes agent execution rather than replacing Hermes with Codex.
risks: Host-local Codex auth/session may sit outside Paperclip secret management and may not be portable to another host.
If Hermes cannot be configured to use Codex CLI through a supported runtime config, the path remains blocked.
A passing smoke must not be worded as fixing OpenAI/Xiaomi secret_ref materialization.
path_comparison.security_posture: Acceptable as local BYOA remediation if no credential values are logged or persisted plaintext and Paperclip remains the execution orchestrator; classify as host-session-dependent unless Paperclip explicitly manages Codex credentials/config.
proof_required: Readback showing selected agent uses adapterType hermes_local.
Registration/testEnvironment readiness for hermes_local under Codex-backed Hermes config, or a blocked artifact explaining which supported config boundary is missing.
One bounded Paperclip run only after fresh explicit execution approval.
Structured result shape: resultJson.bos or resultJson.bosAdapterResult with schema/version, run id, adapter type/path, status, and summary.
Side-effect controls: exactly one wake/run where applicable, zero approvals, zero source writes, no duplicate wake behavior, bounded timeout.
Redaction proof: no provider credential values, auth tokens, session material, or secret-like literals in evidence/log excerpts.
path_comparison.selection_rationale: This is the lowest-violation path that still proves Hermes execution through a Paperclip-owned adapter boundary. It avoids the known hermes_local OpenAI/Xiaomi secret_ref materialization failure without treating Codex as an out-of-band launcher.

dependencies.handling: Mark selected remediation blocked and leave Hermes execution unpromoted.

dependencies.failure_path: Codex command missing, auth/session unavailable, malformed output, or timeout.
dependencies.handling: Record host-session-dependent blocker without logging credentials or session material.

dependencies.failure_path: Run returns text only, no resultJson.bos/resultJson.bosAdapterResult, duplicate wake, side effects, or adapter failure.
dependencies.handling: Fail closed with run id/status/log excerpts and no capability promotion.
